vehicle_target: Maruti Suzuki Alto 800 (2013, 0.8L F8D MPFI Petrol)

P0105.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) Sensor Circuit Malfunction
P0105.f8d_specific_context: On the 2013 Alto 800 F8D engine, the 4-pin integrated MAP/IAT sensor is mounted directly on top of the plastic/aluminum intake manifold plenum (MGP Part #18590-68K00). Oil vapor blow-by from the PCV valve or a cracked vacuum port O-ring frequently contaminates or unseats this sensor.
common_symptoms: Rough or surging idle (fluctuating between 600 and 1,300 RPM)
Black exhaust smoke and strong unburnt petrol smell (rich running)
Hesitation or jerking during initial throttle tip-in
Poor fuel economy (dropping below 12-14 km/L)

probable_causes.cause: Clogged or oil-fouled MAP sensor diaphragm port on intake plenum
Cracked MAP sensor O-ring or intake manifold vacuum leak (brake booster hose / PCV hose)
Faulty MAP/IAT sensor assembly (MGP 18590-68K00)
Open/short in 5V reference (Red/Blue) or MAP signal wire (Light Green/Red) to ECM

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the engine RPM hunt up and down at idle when the A/C is turned off?
diagnostic_questions.impact: High likelihood of intake vacuum leak or contaminated MAP port.

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you notice black soot at the tailpipe or heavy fuel smell?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Indicates MAP signal is stuck high (~4.5V / ~100 kPa), causing ECM to over-fuel.

electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C32 (5V Ref), Pin C44 (MAP Signal), Pin C19 (Sensor Ground)

P0107.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) Barometric Pressure Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
P0107.f8d_specific_context: ECM detected MAP signal voltage below 0.25V for more than 2 seconds on the F8D intake manifold sensor.
common_symptoms: Engine stalls immediately after starting
Severe hesitation and lean misfire under load
Check Engine Light illuminated immediately at key-on

probable_causes.cause: MAP signal wire shorted to ground or 5V reference missing
Disconnected 4-pin MAP sensor connector on top of intake manifold
Internal short in MAP sensor (MGP 18590-68K00)

diagnostic_questions.question: Was the air filter box recently removed for servicing or spark plug access?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Mechanics frequently unplug the MAP sensor under the air cleaner housing and forget to reconnect it.

electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C32 (5V Ref), Pin C44 (MAP Signal)

P0115.title: Engine Coolant Temperature (ECT) Sensor 1 Circuit Malfunction
P0115.f8d_specific_context: The 2-pin NTC thermistor ECT sensor (MGP 13650-78G00) is located on the thermostat housing below the distributor/ignition coil pack side of the F8D cylinder head. It controls cold-start fuel enrichment and the radiator cooling fan relay (ON at 98°C).
common_symptoms: Hard cold starting in the morning (requires multiple cranks)
Radiator cooling fan runs continuously as soon as ignition is turned ON (ECM fail-safe mode)
Inaccurate temperature gauge or overheating warning
Poor fuel economy due to permanent cold-enrichment mode

probable_causes.cause: Failed NTC thermistor inside ECT sensor (MGP 13650-78G00)
Corroded 2-pin ECT connector due to coolant seepage at thermostat housing
Open circuit in Light Green/Black signal wire or Brown/White sensor ground
Stuck-open cooling thermostat (MGP 17670-65G00) preventing engine from reaching 88°C

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the radiator fan spin at full speed immediately when you turn the key to ON with a cold engine?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Confirms ECM sees an open/short in the ECT circuit and has triggered fail-safe fan operation.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: 4.8 - 5.1 V (Connector unplugged, across Pin 1 & 2, Ignition ON)
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C41 (ECT Signal), Pin C19 (Sensor Ground)

P0120.title: Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) / Switch 'A' Circuit Malfunction
P0120.f8d_specific_context: The 2013 Alto 800 uses a cable-operated throttle body with a 3-pin rotary potentiometer TPS mounted on the throttle shaft opposite the accelerator cable cam.
common_symptoms: Delayed throttle response or flat spot when pressing accelerator pedal
High idle speed (stuck at 1,500+ RPM) or stalling when releasing throttle
Jerky gear shifts during deceleration fuel cut-off

probable_causes.cause: Worn carbon resistive track inside TPS potentiometer at 0-15% throttle opening
Carbon buildup around throttle butterfly plate preventing full closure
Loose or oxidized 3-pin TPS harness connector

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the car jerk specifically at light throttle in 2nd or 3rd gear city traffic?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Classic symptom of TPS dead-spot wear in the 5%-20% urban driving range.

electrical_test.signal_koeo_v: 0.45 - 0.65 V (Closed Throttle) -> Smooth sweep to 4.2 - 4.7 V (Wide Open Throttle)
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C32 (5V Ref), Pin C43 (TPS Signal), Pin C19 (Sensor Ground)

P0130.title: O2 Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 1 - Pre-Catalyst)
P0130.f8d_specific_context: 4-wire heated Zirconia upstream Oxygen Sensor (MGP 18213-68K00) mounted in the exhaust manifold collector directly in front of the F8D engine block.
common_symptoms: 15-25% drop in fuel mileage
Failed PUC (Pollution Under Control) emissions test (High CO / HC)
Slight rough idle once engine warms up into closed-loop mode

probable_causes.cause: Aged or contaminated upstream O2 sensor element (MGP 18213-68K00)
Exhaust manifold gasket leak upstream of O2 sensor
Melted O2 sensor wiring harness touching hot exhaust heat shield

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your fuel efficiency dropped significantly without any major loss of engine power?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Upstream O2 sensor sluggish response forces open-loop rich fuel mapping.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: 0.45 V bias voltage (Key ON, Cold) | Heater supply 12V on White/Red wire
electrical_test.resistance_spec: Heater coil (2 same-color wires): 5.0 - 9.5 Ω at 20°C
electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: Rapid oscillation between 0.15 V (Lean) and 0.85 V (Rich) at 2,000 RPM
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C46 (O2S-1 Signal), Pin C05 (O2S-1 Heater Control)

P0171.title: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
P0171.f8d_specific_context: Long Term Fuel Trim (LTFT) has exceeded +25% on the F8D engine, meaning the ECM is adding maximum fuel to compensate for excess air or insufficient fuel rail pressure.
common_symptoms: Loss of power when climbing slopes or with A/C ON
Engine pinging / knocking under acceleration
High or unstable idle speed

probable_causes.cause: Vacuum leak at intake manifold gasket, PCV valve hose, or brake booster vacuum line
Weak in-tank fuel pump or clogged fuel filter (pressure below 3.0 bar / 300 kPa)
Partially clogged fuel injectors (3 injectors on F8D rail)
Exhaust leak before upstream O2 sensor drawing false air

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the engine run smoother at high RPM (3,000 RPM) than at idle (800 RPM)?
diagnostic_questions.impact: If fuel trims improve at 3,000 RPM, the root cause is an intake vacuum leak. If it stays lean or worsens under load, suspect low fuel pump pressure.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: 12.0 - 14.2 V at Fuel Pump Relay and Injector Common Supply
electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: LTFT + STFT combined should return within ±10% after repair
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pins C01, C02, C03 (Injector 1, 2, 3 Drivers)

P0300.title: Random / Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected (F8D 3-Cylinder)
P0300.f8d_specific_context: Because the F8D is a 3-cylinder 796cc engine (firing order 1-3-2), any misfire causes pronounced cabin vibration and immediate loss of pulling power. Flashing Check Engine Light warns of catalytic converter overheating risk.
common_symptoms: Severe engine shaking / vibration felt in steering wheel and gear lever
Flashing or steady Check Engine Light
Popping / chugging sound from exhaust pipe
Struggles to climb inclines even in 1st or 2nd gear

probable_causes.cause: Worn or oil/carbon-fouled spark plugs (NGK DCPR7E, gap > 1.0 mm)
Failing ignition coil pack or leaking high-tension spark plug cords
Tight exhaust valve clearance or burnt exhaust valve (common on high-mileage / LPG-CNG F8D engines)
Low fuel rail pressure or contaminated petrol

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the Check Engine Light blinking/flashing while driving?
diagnostic_questions.impact: SAFETY CRITICAL: Unburnt fuel is entering the catalytic converter. Avoid heavy load driving until ignition is repaired.

diagnostic_questions.question: Have the spark plugs been used for more than 20,000 km?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Standard nickel NGK DCPR7E plugs on the Alto 800 require inspection every 10,000 km and replacement every 20,000 km.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: 12V Battery supply on Black/White wire at Ignition Coil connector
electrical_test.resistance_spec: Primary coil: 0.5 - 1.5 Ω | HT Cord resistance: 3 - 10 kΩ
electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: Clean 12V-0V primary switching pulse on ECM coil driver pins
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pins C14, C15, C16 (Ignition Coil Drivers)

P0301.title: Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected (Timing Belt End)
P0301.f8d_specific_context: Crankshaft acceleration tooth-time variation detected specifically on Cylinder #1 (closest to the camshaft timing belt cover on the left side of the engine bay).
common_symptoms: Rhythmic engine shaking at idle (running on 2 cylinders)
Strong smell of raw fuel
Loss of 33% engine torque

probable_causes.cause: Faulty Cylinder #1 spark plug (NGK DCPR7E) or Cylinder #1 ignition coil/boot
Clogged or electrically open Cylinder #1 fuel injector (MGP 15710-68K00)
Low compression in Cylinder #1 (< 11.5 bar) due to valve seating or head gasket

diagnostic_questions.question: If you swap the spark plug and coil from Cylinder 1 to Cylinder 2, does the fault code move to P0302?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Swapping ignition components between cylinders 1 and 2 isolates a bad plug/coil in 5 minutes without buying parts blindly.

electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: 3.2 - 3.8 ms injector pulse width at warm idle

P0335.title: Crankshaft Position Sensor (CKP) 'A' Circuit Malfunction
P0335.f8d_specific_context: Inductive/Hall CKP sensor (MGP 33220-76G30) reading the toothed reluctor wheel on the F8D crankshaft pulley/flywheel end. Without CKP signal, the ECM disables both fuel injection and spark.
common_symptoms: Engine cranks normally on starter motor but will NOT start (No Spark, No Fuel Pulse)
Sudden engine stall when engine gets hot in traffic, then restarts after cooling down for 20 minutes
Tachometer / RPM reading stays at 0 RPM while cranking

probable_causes.cause: Heat-degraded internal coil in CKP sensor (MGP 33220-76G30)
Metal shavings or oil sludge coating magnetic tip of CKP sensor (air gap > 1.2 mm)
Damaged CKP wiring near crankshaft pulley or loose 2/3-pin connector

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the engine stall when hot and start working again after cooling down?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Thermal expansion opens a hairline fracture inside the CKP sensor copper winding — a classic F8D failure mode.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: Inductive AC output during cranking: > 0.5 V AC RMS (or 5V Hall pulse depending on ECM type)
electrical_test.resistance_spec: Inductive CKP coil resistance: 480 - 650 Ω at 20°C
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pin C27 (CKP+), Pin C28 (CKP-), Pin C29 (Shield)

P0500.title: Vehicle Speed Sensor (VSS) 'A' Malfunction
P0500.f8d_specific_context: 3-pin Hall-effect Vehicle Speed Sensor mounted on the 5-speed manual transaxle differential housing. Feeds speed pulses to both the instrument cluster odometer/speedometer and the ECM (for idle decay and Electric Power Steering assist damping).
common_symptoms: Speedometer needle drops to 0 km/h while driving
Engine stalls when pressing the clutch pedal while slowing down for a speed breaker or stop
Power steering (EPS on VXi/LXi) feels unusually heavy or light at highway speeds

probable_causes.cause: Failed 3-pin Hall VSS sensor on gearbox housing (MGP 34960-68K00)
Stripped plastic speedometer driven gear inside transaxle
Broken wire or oil contamination in VSS 3-pin plug at back of gearbox

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the dashboard speedometer needle also dead (showing 0 km/h) when the car is moving?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Confirms the VSS sensor or its driven gear on the gearbox is not generating square-wave pulses.

electrical_test.reference_voltage_v: Pin 1: 12V Ignition | Pin 2: Ground | Pin 3: Signal (0V - 5V/12V pulse)
electrical_test.resistance_spec: Hall IC sensor — do not measure resistance directly across IC pins; measure voltage pulse while rotating front wheel
electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: Alternating 0V to 4.8V square wave (4 pulses per revolution) when lifted front wheel is spun

P0505.title: Idle Air Control (IACV) System Malfunction
P0505.f8d_specific_context: Stepper-motor / rotary duty-solenoid Idle Air Control Valve (MGP 18137-79G01) mounted on the bottom/side of the F8D throttle body. Controls bypass air during cold fast-idle and A/C compressor load compensation.
common_symptoms: Engine stalls immediately when turning ON the A/C at idle
No fast-idle (1,200 RPM) during cold morning start; requires holding accelerator pedal to keep engine running
Idle stuck high at 1,600 - 2,000 RPM

probable_causes.cause: Carbon and gummy blow-by deposits jamming the IACV pintle/bypass passage in throttle body
Open winding in IACV stepper motor coils (MGP 18137-79G01)
Faulty IACV connector or ECM stepper driver output

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the RPM drop below 550 RPM or stall as soon as the A/C compressor clicks ON?
diagnostic_questions.impact: Directly points to a carbon-stuck IACV bypass passage unable to add load-compensation air.

electrical_test.resistance_spec: Each stepper coil winding: 28 - 36 Ω at 20°C
electrical_test.signal_warm_idle_v: IACV Step Position: 15 - 35 steps (A/C OFF) | 40 - 65 steps (A/C ON)
electrical_test.ecm_pins: ECM Pins C08, C09, C10, C11 (IACV Stepper Coils 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B)
